source: MASSIVE 1.1 pt-PT, allowed train/development; reserved workers and original test withheld
hypothesis: A bounded bidirectional ordered context shared by separate intent and BIO heads can preserve token order and improve unseen span roles without increasing the seed or loading a language model.
representation: AXSQ0015 combines the existing ordered-context page with split intent/BIO mixers. It is a distinct codec; old split and old ordered codecs remain readable. Characters stay disabled because the existing ordered-context contract forbids combining them.
controls: Policy 0 is the frozen split-head control. Policies 1 and 2 change only ordered context and token-loss normalization. All policies share seed, vocabulary, dimensions, hidden width, epochs, optimizer, dropout and relative regions. Development selects the winner; reserved workers and original test remain untouched until a separate audit.
scope: Diagnostic M1 experiment only. It cannot certify M1 or permit M2 unless every required gate is independently re-run under evals/protocols/m1-completion-v1.json.
